caps_absent.boot_console: wolfBoot's STM32L5 console is LPUART1, which the M33MU STM32L552 model does not attach
caps_absent.dma_probe: every DMA1 and DMA2 channel is held Secure, so a guest has no Non-secure DMA to aim
caps_absent.guest_fence: the STM32L5 guest write protection is the option-byte WRP that provisioning sets, not a first-stage fence
caps_absent.idcode: no silicon revision gate on this port
caps_absent.bootupdate: the STM32L562 emulator chain does not stage a wolfBoot update candidate yet
caps_absent.vnet: no wolfIP network guests for this port
caps_absent.idle_scheduler: the single-guest idle backoff scenario is not wired for this port
caps_absent.handler_overrun: the Non-secure handler overrun scenario is not wired for this port
caps_absent.busfault: M33MU at the pinned ref does not vector a precise data BusFault

faults_by_design.periphneg: the bare-metal probe's NS read of the RNG faults on every launch and the monitor contains it
faults_by_design.crossdomain: the storage SP's probe faults on its first wake while both guests finish; the trace boot names the fault
faults_by_design.keystoreneg: the storage SP's probe faults on its first wake while both guests finish; the trace boot names the fault
faults_by_design.periphspneg: the storage SP's probe faults on its first wake while the PSA guest finishes

caps_absent.rom_xip: the DK boots through wolfBoot in internal flash; there is no XIP ROM smoke image
caps_absent.ns_handler_probes: the NS entry-mask and parked-IRQ probes are not run on this board
caps_absent.pris: the Non-secure mask negatives are the Nucleo's (AIRCR.PRIS probe in the Zephyr guest)

caps_absent.write_once: the WRITE_ONCE reset probe lives in the Zephyr PSA guest
